title: Pork Stew with Polish Touch
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender pork and infused with the subtle taste of Poland.
instructions: Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Heat the vodka in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the diced pork and sear until browned on all sides.
Add the stew, polish sausage, zesty paprika, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and let cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill.
